emoticon_items_has_image_check.name: emoticon_items_has_image_check
emoticon_items_has_image_check.value: "still_image_id" IS NOT NULL OR "animated_image_id" IS NOT NULL

media_pending_purge_idx.name: media_pending_purge_idx
media_pending_purge_idx.where: "deleted_at" IS NOT NULL AND "r2_purged_at" IS NULL

media_expiry_idx.name: media_expiry_idx
media_expiry_idx.where: "expires_at" IS NOT NULL AND "deleted_at" IS NULL

media_voice_has_peaks_check.name: media_voice_has_peaks_check
media_voice_has_peaks_check.value: "kind" <> 'voice' OR ("waveform_peaks" IS NOT NULL AND "duration_ms" IS NOT NULL)

media_box_is_visual_check.name: media_box_is_visual_check
media_box_is_visual_check.value: "kind" NOT IN ('image','video') OR ("width" IS NOT NULL AND "height" IS NOT NULL)

media_no_box_when_not_visual_check.name: media_no_box_when_not_visual_check
media_no_box_when_not_visual_check.value: "kind" IN ('image','video') OR ("width" IS NULL AND "height" IS NULL AND "blurhash" IS NULL)

messages_changed_id_idx.name: messages_changed_id_idx
messages_changed_id_idx.where: "deleted_at" IS NOT NULL OR "edited_at" IS NOT NULL OR "collapsed_at" IS NOT NULL

messages_type_payload_check.name: messages_type_payload_check
messages_type_payload_check.value:
CASE "type"
        WHEN 'text' THEN "text" IS NOT NULL AND "emoticon_item_id" IS NULL AND "event_id" IS NULL AND "system_action" IS NULL AND "event_title" IS NULL AND "event_starts_at" IS NULL AND "llm_provider" IS NULL AND "llm_model" IS NULL
        WHEN 'media' THEN "text" IS NULL AND "emoticon_item_id" IS NULL AND "event_id" IS NULL AND "system_action" IS NULL AND "event_title" IS NULL AND "event_starts_at" IS NULL AND "llm_provider" IS NULL AND "llm_model" IS NULL
        WHEN 'emoticon' THEN "text" IS NULL AND "emoticon_item_id" IS NOT NULL AND "event_id" IS NULL AND "system_action" IS NULL AND "event_title" IS NULL AND "event_starts_at" IS NULL AND "llm_provider" IS NULL AND "llm_model" IS NULL
        WHEN 'system' THEN "emoticon_item_id" IS NULL AND (
          ("system_action"::text = 'assistant_reply' AND "text" IS NOT NULL AND "event_id" IS NULL AND "event_title" IS NULL AND "event_starts_at" IS NULL AND "llm_provider" IS NOT NULL AND "llm_model" IS NOT NULL)
          OR
          ("system_action" IS NOT NULL AND "system_action"::text <> 'assistant_reply' AND "text" IS NULL AND "event_title" IS NOT NULL AND "event_starts_at" IS NOT NULL AND "llm_provider" IS NULL AND "llm_model" IS NULL)
        )
      END
